definition: Psychiatric conditions, their diagnosis, treatment and care, and psychological wellbeing. General "mental health" with nothing more specific takes this parent. Autism and ADHD go to `neurodevelopment`; stress physiology and regulation practices to `stress`.

row: | depression | Depression | Depression as a condition or a sustained depressive state, named as such: diagnosis, episodes, symptoms, treatment, rates. Low mood short of that goes to `mental.wellbeing_grief_loneliness`; a momentary reaction ("I'm so depressed we lost") is not health content. | depression; major depressive disorder; treatment-resistant depression; depressive episode; "I've struggled with depression"; postpartum depression |

| anxiety | Anxiety & panic | Anxiety disorders, panic attacks, and anxiety as an ongoing condition or symptom. Ordinary worry or nervousness about an event is not health content. | anxiety disorder; panic attacks; generalized anxiety; social anxiety; "my anxiety"; health anxiety |

| trauma_ptsd | Trauma & PTSD | Psychological trauma and its effects, including PTSD, childhood adversity, and repressed or recovered memories of trauma. Trauma said to cause physical illness also takes `stress.mind_body`; brain injury goes to `neuro.concussion_tbi` and physical injury to `acute_care.trauma_fractures`. | PTSD; CPTSD; combat PTSD; childhood trauma; ACEs; trauma response; "the body keeps the score"; repressed memories; recovered-memory therapy |

| ocd_personality | OCD, intrusive thoughts & personality disorders | OCD and related disorders (body dysmorphia included), intrusive thoughts in the clinical sense, and personality disorders and traits as clinical categories, psychopathy included. Muscle dysmorphia goes to `manosphere.male_body_image`. Insults and loose description ("a narcissist", "a psychopath", "a little OCD", "intrusive thought" for a hot take) are not health content. | OCD; exposure and response prevention; postpartum intrusive thoughts; body dysmorphia; borderline personality disorder; narcissistic personality disorder (as diagnosis); psychopathy; antisocial personality disorder; pathological lying |

| wellbeing_grief_loneliness | Wellbeing, mood, grief & loneliness | Psychological wellbeing as a subject: happiness, loneliness, grief and bereavement, purpose, resilience, burnout as emotional state, and mood (low or good mood, mood swings, irritability) short of a diagnosed disorder. A real person's grief or loneliness narrated as part of a story is not this label unless the state itself or its effects are discussed. | loneliness epidemic; crisis of loneliness; grief; grieving process; happiness; resilience; emotional health; mental wellness; improve your mood; mood swings; irritability |

| pop_psychology | Pop psychology & self-diagnosis | Popular psychological vocabulary (therapy-speak), self-diagnosis as a social phenomenon, self-help about spotting and handling "narcissists", attachment styles, and claims that mental-health diagnoses in general are over-applied or normal feelings pathologized. Abuse in a relationship discussed as harm goes to `acute_care.violence_abuse`; narcissistic personality disorder as a diagnosis to `mental.ocd_personality`; overdiagnosis of one disorder also takes that disorder's subtopic. | therapy-speak; self-diagnosing on TikTok; attachment styles; trauma bonding; love bombing; how to spot a narcissist; "everyone has ADHD now"; overdiagnosis; pathologizing normal feelings |

| behavioral_addictions | Behavioral addictions | Compulsive behaviors treated as an addiction or disorder: loss of control, harm, treatment, recovery. Casual "I'm addicted to my phone" about heavy use goes to `cognition.digital_media_brain`. | porn addiction; gambling addiction; sports-betting addiction; gaming disorder; shopping addiction; sex addiction |

| causes_models | Causes & models of mental illness | General theories of what causes mental illness (trauma, perception, inflammation, metabolism and diet, chemical imbalance, social determinants) not tied to one disorder. | chemical imbalance theory; root of mental illness; metabolic psychiatry; nutritional psychiatry; social determinants of mental health; poverty and mental illness; biopsychosocial model |

| psychiatric_care | Psychiatric care, hospitalization & mental-health system | How psychiatric care is delivered, accessed and enforced: psychiatric hospitals and holds, involuntary commitment, asylums and deinstitutionalization, access to psychiatrists (psychiatric telehealth included), non-drug somatic treatments (ECT, TMS, stellate ganglion block, lobotomy as history), and psychiatric evaluation in the courts (insanity defense, competency). Drugs go to `mental.psychiatric_drugs`, talk therapy to `mental.therapy`, ketamine and psychedelics to `psychoactives`. | psych ward; 5150; Baker Act; involuntary commitment; state mental hospital; deinstitutionalization; insanity defense; competent to stand trial; ECT; TMS; Talkiatry |

| adhd | ADHD | ADHD diagnosis, prevalence and treatment, including prescribed stimulant medication. Stimulants taken without ADHD to study or work go to `cognition.nootropics` and party use to `drugs_addiction.stimulants_illicit`; a simile ("like I took an Adderall") is not health content. | ADHD; adult ADHD; Adderall; Ritalin; Vyvanse; stimulant shortage; ADHD overdiagnosis |

| neurodiversity | Neurodiversity & living with autism | Neurodivergence as identity, culture and accommodation, and everyday life with autism for autistic people and their families: adult and late diagnosis, masking, support needs, nonverbal communication, school and work. Causes and rates go to `neurodevelopment.autism_causes_prevalence`; therapies to `neurodevelopment.autism_treatment`. | neurodivergent; neurodiversity; autistic masking; late autism diagnosis; nonverbal autistic child; autism mom; autistic identity |

| developmental_delays | Developmental delays, learning disabilities & tic disorders | Speech, motor and learning delays, learning disabilities, intellectual disability, and tic disorders beginning in childhood or adolescence (Tourette's, functional tics). Genetic syndromes (Down syndrome) go to `genetics.genetic_conditions`; tics beginning in adulthood to `neuro.other_neurological`. | speech delay; dyslexia; developmental milestones missed; learning disability; intellectual disability; Tourette's; tics; TikTok tics |

| stress_burnout | Stress & burnout | Stress, chronic stress and burnout and their effects on health, including "cortisol" used colloquially to mean stress ("don't spike your cortisol"). Cortisol measured or discussed as a hormone goes to `endocrine.cortisol_adrenal`. | chronic stress; burnout; stress kills; good stress vs bad stress; "spiking my cortisol" |

| nervous_system_regulation | Nervous-system regulation | The vocabulary and practices of nervous-system regulation, including vagus-nerve stimulation devices worn for calm or sleep (which also take `biohacking.devices_gadgets`). | vagus nerve; fight or flight; polyvagal; somatic therapy; dysregulated nervous system; EFT tapping; vagus nerve stimulator; NeuroPod |

| nature_grounding | Nature exposure & grounding | Time outdoors and physical contact with the earth (earthing) as health practices, and products sold for it. "Grounding" meaning calming or stabilizing is not this label. | earthing; grounding mat; grounding sheets; forest bathing; barefoot on the grass; nature time; green space |

| mind_body | Mind-body connection | Emotions, beliefs, trauma, social connection and psychological state said to affect physical illness, immunity or recovery (psychoneuroimmunology, psychosomatic illness). "Mind-body connection" as a product slogan or as exercise technique is not this label. | molecules of emotion; isolation weakens immunity; psychoneuroimmunology; psychosomatic illness; emotions stored in the body; beliefs and healing |

| dreams_parasomnias | Dreams, parasomnias & narcolepsy | Dreaming as a sleep or brain phenomenon (lucid dreaming, nightmares, what dreams are for), parasomnias (sleep paralysis, sleepwalking, night terrors, sleep talking) and narcolepsy, whatever explanation is offered for them. Recounting what happened in a dream is not health content; restless legs goes to `neuro.other_neurological`. | lucid dreaming; recurring nightmares; sleep paralysis; sleepwalking; night terrors; narcolepsy |

| focus_productivity | Focus & attention | Concentration and attention as a capacity of the brain that is trained, impaired or improved (by sleep, diet, practices, substances or devices). Productivity methods, work habits and "attention span" as a cultural complaint with no health claim are not this label. | focus; ability to concentrate; attention span (as brain capacity); flow state (as brain state); mental clarity; executive function |

| memory_learning | Memory, learning & intelligence | Memory, learning and intelligence in healthy people, including IQ as an outcome of an exposure (which also takes the exposure's subtopic). Age-related change goes to `dementia_ageing.cognitive_ageing`; intellectual disability to `neurodevelopment.developmental_delays`; "low IQ" as an insult is not health content. | memory; learning; neuroplasticity; recall; IQ points; lowers IQ in kids; intelligence research |

| nootropics | Nootropics & smart drugs | Substances and branded blends taken to enhance cognition, including prescription stimulants or modafinil used without a diagnosis to study or work. Methylene blue for other purposes goes to `medications.repurposed_offlabel`. | nootropics; modafinil; racetams; Alpha Brain; Magic Mind; Adderall to study; methylene blue for cognition; lion's mane for focus |

| brain_fog | Brain fog | Brain fog as a symptom and its causes. When the fog is discussed in its own right alongside its cause (menopause, long COVID, a diet), also code the cause's subtopic. | brain fog; mental fog; can't think clearly; foggy |

| neurochemistry_talk | Dopamine & neurotransmitter talk | Popular talk about dopamine, serotonin and other neurotransmitters as levers of behavior or mood, when the brain chemistry is the point. "Dopamine hit" as a bare metaphor for a reward feeling is not health content. | dopamine hit; cheap dopamine; dopamine detox; dopamine fasting; serotonin "happy hormone"; serotonin is made in the gut |

| digital_media_brain | Screens, social media & the brain | Effects of phones, screens and social media on attention, mood and development, and policies aimed at them (phone-free schools, age limits for children). Compulsive use treated as an addiction or disorder goes to `mental.behavioral_addictions`; "screen time" meaning TV airtime and "brain rot" as an insult are not this label. | screen time for kids; social media and teens; The Anxious Generation; phone-free schools; under-16 social media ban; smartphones and attention |

| menstrual_cycle | Menstrual cycle & periods | The cycle and its problems, including lost or absent periods from under-eating, over-training or stopping the pill. Age at first period and early puberty go to `pediatrics.puberty_adolescence`. | menstrual cycle; PMS; PMDD; irregular periods; heavy bleeding; period pain; amenorrhea; lost my period; RED-S; cycle syncing |

| hormone_therapy | Menopausal hormone therapy | Prescribed hormones for menopause and testosterone for women, including bioidentical hormones and vaginal estrogen. "HRT" said of men means testosterone replacement (`mens.testosterone`); said of transgender people, `gender.adult_transition` or `gender.youth_gender_medicine`. | HRT; MHT; estrogen patch; vaginal estrogen; progesterone; bioidentical hormones; testosterone pellets for women; WHI study; black-box warning |
| pcos | PCOS | Polycystic ovary syndrome, under either name. | PCOS; polycystic ovaries; PMOS; insulin-resistant PCOS |

| period_products | Period products & their safety | Tampons, pads, cups and period underwear, and claims about their contents or safety. | tampons; organic tampons; bleach or chemicals in tampons; organic pads; period underwear; menstrual cup; toxic shock |

| pelvic_floor | Pelvic floor | Pelvic floor function and therapy in any sex, including leaking from pelvic-floor weakness (stress incontinence, postpartum leaks). Other bladder and urinary problems go to `kidney_lung.kidney_urinary`. | pelvic floor; Kegels; pelvic floor therapy; prolapse; bladder leaks; leaks when I sneeze; stress incontinence |

| pregnancy_health | Pregnancy health & complications | Prenatal care and complications of pregnancy, including pregnancy loss and ectopic pregnancy. Treatment of miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy under abortion laws also takes `fertility.abortion`. | prenatal care; prenatal vitamins; gestational diabetes; preeclampsia; miscarriage; pregnancy loss; stillbirth; ectopic pregnancy; morning sickness; hyperemesis |

| postpartum | Postpartum | The postpartum period and recovery. Postpartum depression, psychosis or hair loss also takes the condition's own subtopic (`mental.depression`, `mental.serious_mental_illness`, `skin_beauty.hair_loss_hair`). | postpartum depression; postpartum psychosis; baby blues; postpartum recovery; postpartum hair loss; fourth trimester; diastasis recti; placenta encapsulation |

| maternal_mortality_access | Maternal & infant mortality and maternity care access | Maternal and infant deaths and their rates, and access to maternity care. A single sudden infant death goes to `pediatrics.infant_care`. | maternal mortality; maternal deaths; dying in childbirth; infant mortality rate; maternal health outcomes |

| contraception | Contraception | Birth control of any kind, including hormonal contraceptives taken for acne or PCOS, male contraceptives, and birth-control access programmes. | the pill; Opill; IUD; implant; condoms; vasectomy; male birth control pill; natural family planning; fertility awareness; Title X family planning; the pill for acne |

| abortion | Abortion | Abortion procedures, pills, safety, access and the law, and arguments over abortion itself. Miscarriage or ectopic-pregnancy care under abortion laws also takes `pregnancy.pregnancy_health`. | abortion; mifepristone; misoprostol; abortion pill; late-term abortion; abortion access; abortion bans; Roe; Dobbs |

| sexual_function | Sexual function & libido | Desire, arousal and performance in any sex, including claimed effects of pornography on sexual function. Porn addiction as a compulsion goes to `mental.behavioral_addictions`. | erectile dysfunction; ED treatments; Viagra; Cialis; libido; low sex drive; orgasm; premature ejaculation; vaginismus; sexual pain; porn-induced ED |

| testosterone | Testosterone & TRT | Testosterone levels, decline, boosting and replacement therapy in men, including "HRT" for men and andropause. Testosterone named only as a marker of manhood or politics ("high-T men", "soy boys") goes to `manosphere.masculinity_ideology`. | low T; TRT; HRT for men; testosterone boosters; declining testosterone; andropause; male menopause; estrogen in men; enclomiphene |

| genital_health | Testicular & penile health | Testicular and penile health, and circumcision of older boys and men. Newborn circumcision goes to `pediatrics.infant_care`. | testicles; testicular pain; varicocele; adult circumcision; foreskin; Peyronie's |

| semen_retention_nofap | Semen retention & NoFap | Abstaining from ejaculation or masturbation for claimed health, energy or hormonal benefits. "Monk mode" as general focus or abstinence from distractions is not this label. | semen retention; NoFap; no nut November; retaining your seed |

| looksmaxxing | Looksmaxxing & appearance hacks | Practices to change facial or bodily appearance promoted in online male subcultures, and their "-maxxing" vocabulary. | looksmaxxing; mewing; bone smashing; jawline; mogging; leg lengthening surgery |

| masculinity_ideology | Masculinity ideology & health | Red-pill or alpha framing of male health: claims that men's bodies, hormones or fertility are being weakened or feminized, "soy boy" rhetoric about men's bodies, and testosterone used as a marker of manhood or politics. The manosphere or red pill discussed only as a political or cultural movement is not this label. | soy boys; "men are being feminized"; high-T men; "they want weak men"; alpha male (as biology) |

| male_body_image | Male body image & muscle dysmorphia | Pressure on men's bodies and muscle dysmorphia. Body dysmorphia in general goes to `mental.ocd_personality` (or `mental.eating_disorders` when it is about eating); body dysmorphia invoked to explain gender dysphoria goes to `gender.gender_identity_science`. | muscle dysmorphia; male body dysmorphia; male body image; bigorexia |

| youth_gender_medicine | Gender medicine for minors | Any intervention for minors, social transition included: puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones and surgery, and laws, reviews and guidelines concerning them. Add `gender.gender_identity_science` when whether children can know or should be affirmed is also argued. | puberty blockers; gender-affirming care for kids; WPATH; Cass Review; gender clinics for children; bans on youth transition; Skrmetti; social transition |

| adult_transition | Adult transition care | Hormones and surgery for transgender adults, and transition procedures discussed with no age stated. When the passage is about minors, use `gender.youth_gender_medicine`. | sex change; gender reassignment surgery; HRT for trans adults; top surgery; bottom surgery; vaginoplasty; phalloplasty |

| lgbtq_health | LGBTQ health, disparities & orientation | Health issues and disparities of LGBTQ people outside transition care, conversion therapy, and claims about the origins of sexual orientation (genetic, hormonal, chosen). A specific condition (suicide, HIV) also takes its own subtopic. | LGBTQ mental health; conversion therapy; trans suicide statistics; gay gene; born this way; homosexuality is biological |

| trans_athletes | Transgender & DSD athletes | Physical sex differences as they bear on transgender and intersex (DSD) athletes: male-puberty advantage, testosterone suppression and eligibility rules, sex testing, and injury risk to competitors. A slogan such as "men in women's sports" with nothing about bodies or health is not health content. | male puberty advantage; suppress your testosterone; sex testing; Lia Thomas; Imane Khelif; injuries to female athletes |

| infant_care | Newborn & infant care | Caring for newborns and infants, including newborn procedures (vitamin K shot, newborn circumcision), NICU care and newborn sleep safety (SIDS, sleep position, co-sleeping). Infant mortality rates go to `pregnancy.maternal_mortality_access`; children's sleep routines to `sleep.sleep_hygiene_environment`. | newborn care; NICU; vitamin K shot; newborn circumcision; safe infant sleep; co-sleeping; SIDS; colic; tummy time; swaddling |

| pediatric_care | Pediatric care | The experience of children's medical care: pediatric visits, children's dosing and pediatrician relationships. A pediatrician's vaccine advice or a family's vaccine dispute with a pediatrician goes to `vaccines.uptake_hesitancy`, plus this label only when the care relationship itself is discussed; a childhood illness takes its own subtopic plus a population label. | pediatrician; well-child visit; children's dosing; kids' medications; finding a pediatrician |
